desc.zh: 镜像构造回文平方根，完整检查超级回文数。
desc.en: Mirror square roots and prove a complete super-palindrome search.

complexity: O(R^(1/4) log R) time; O(log R) auxiliary space, R = int(right)

concepts.name: Palindromic root generation
concepts.description: Odd/even mirroring gives every positive palindromic root exactly once.

concepts.name: Super-palindrome filtering
concepts.description: Inclusive bounds and the second palindrome test.
